correction: The port believed that running Palette.RunPending at the top of Shell.View makes a palette command show in the same frame. Reality: an app's View that captures the page and takes its toasts before it calls Shell.View draws the old page and holds the command's toast for a frame. An app that captures state before Shell.View must call Palette.RunPending first.
evidence: PR #282 cross-review M11, re-review M14; TestPaletteCommandDrawsItsPageInTheFrameThatRunsIt and TestPaletteCommandToastShowsInTheFrameThatRunsIt in internal/window/main_test.go, both failing with the call removed
